question: Do independently published pre-soft-s sources provide a symmetry-protected or RG-fixed relation that uniquely selects the surviving universal-HMT physical-metric matter-interface couplings before any RTK response comparison?

independent_sources.role: source-lock that the universal physical-ADM interface retains two arbitrary constants and lacks an obvious UV action-principle origin
independent projectable-Horava radiative-stability audit for matter Lorentz restoration and fine tuning

decision_rule: PROTECTED_UNIQUE requires an audited source to derive a definite symmetry- or RG-protected relation that fixes every scalar-response-relevant universal-HMT interface parameter without using RTK pole/residue/remainder or the later soft-s obstruction. NO_PROTECTED_UNIQUE_SELECTOR applies if the HMT universal-coupling source keeps the interface constants arbitrary while the independent projectable-Horava radiative analysis identifies fine-tuning and only candidate mechanisms such as RG flow or supersymmetry rather than deriving a unique fixed relation for the HMT interface. INCOMPLETE applies if these source statements cannot be locked. The result is scoped to the audited sources and is not a literature-wide no-go or a C9 closure.
required_guards: sources independent of current RTK soft-s obstruction
do not infer technical naturalness from classical U(1) invariance alone
do not choose a1 or a2 from RTK pole/residue/remainder
do not choose a1 or a2 from soft-s data
do not promote proposed RG or supersymmetry scenarios to a derived fixed relation
do not claim C9 naturalness closure
